summary: Micromem Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached news release providing an update on its wearable sensing platform for defence applications. The filing describes completion of a cost analysis and engineering review for a prototype, noting it meets weight and cost targets (under 250g, under $1000 CAD per unit) and an anticipated initial annual order from the DND of ~5,000 units. There are no deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, or any special-situation corporate event. The filing is a routine business update with no transaction or activist involvement, hence classified as None.
